Use case: illustration-story / wordless mobile-game help diagram. ONE landscape illustration, exact 8:5 aspect ratio, designed for export at 800x500. Original warm hand-painted storybook watercolor/gouache, softly inked brown contours, simple large forms. Match the existing reference game icons' material, colors, upper-left lighting and gentle brushwork. Warm wood brown, moss green, cream, terracotta, blue-gray. Background is a uniform SOLID pale parchment color #f6ecd4 across the whole canvas; no paper stains, texture noise, horizon or scenery beyond the few necessary subjects. Keep clear 7% margins.
If a hand appears, use exactly ONE cute rounded cartoon human hand with warm peach skin, a short plain ivory shirt cuff, no body or face. It should be anatomically coherent, simple and friendly, not realistic, no extra fingers. Any visible hand uses this same design.
Explain actions ONLY with broad clear hand-painted direction ARROWS and a few tiny golden four-point SPARKLES. No letters, text, numbers, labels, speech bubbles, logo or watermark anywhere; do not paint a device screen, outer border, ornamental frame or background disc. No pixel art, anime, flat vector or smooth 3D. Plenty of blank parchment for visual breathing room. Foreground subjects gently textured but not dense or fussy.
SCENE: A single squat leafy green village TREE on the left-center, entire tree visible from canopy to roots, with warm-brown trunk. On its right, ONE cartoon hand points its index finger leftward and gently touches the trunk, thumb and three other fingers naturally curled. A small golden contact sparkle sits precisely at the fingertip touching the bark. Three chunky little WOOD CHIPS jump UPWARD from that contact area above/right of the trunk, following one short curved upward arrow. Show a clear tap-and-harvest action, not chopping: no axe, no injured character, no hand holding a chip. Tree, hand and chips are the only main subjects on blank parchment.
